note: An attacker-controlled projection token from the map file is copied into the projection argument array.
The argument count advances without any bound check, allowing more tokens to be stored than the fixed array can hold.
The parser should ensure the number of collected projection arguments stays within the allocated capacity before later processing uses them.
The projection loader allocates space for only two argument pointers, so any larger argument count is unsafe.
Processing the oversized projection definition later reads/writes past the two-element argument array, triggering the heap buffer overflow.
